panels.title: Pipeline Telemetry Scope & Collection Boundaries
panels.description: Operational scope of telemetry ingested versus filtered at perimeter edge.

options.content:
### Scope & Collection Boundaries
- **Collected Threat Streams**: FortiOS UTM Security Profiles (`type="utm"` — IPS, Antivirus, WAF, SSL Anomaly) and Perimeter Denies (`type="traffic" action="deny"`).
- **Not Collected / Filtered at Ingest**: Forward traffic session accept/close (`type="traffic" action="accept"`) are explicitly dropped at normalization to conserve database bandwidth and avoid false positive noise. Contextual traffic enrichment is queried on-demand directly from Loki.
- **Endpoint Telemetry**: Pure endpoint agent logs without perimeter firewall correlation are not ingested.
